releases.description:
VaultQuiz 1.0.1 — passes Obsidian's automated plugin review.

- Fixes the `minAppVersion` / `Workspace.revealLeaf` API-version error (now requires Obsidian 1.7.2+)
- Removes all unsafe `any` typing, floating promises, and other lint findings
- No behaviour changes

## Install
- **BRAT**: `FilhoRicardo/vaultquiz`
- **Manual**: download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, `styles.css` into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/vaultquiz/`

releases.author: FilhoRicardo
releases.description:
VaultQuiz 1.0.0 — turn your Obsidian notes into a daily multiple-choice quiz with a study streak. Bring your own LLM key (MiniMax, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible API).

## Install
- **BRAT**: add the beta plugin `FilhoRicardo/vaultquiz`.
- **Manual**: download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` below into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/vaultquiz/`, then enable in Settings → Community plugins.

## Highlights
- Daily quiz generated from folders you pick; participation streak with freezes
- One-screen dashboard (streak, today, 30-day accuracy, heatmap)
- Best-effort daily auto-generate; optional Markdown result log
- Desktop + mobile; plays offline once generated

## Privacy
Sampled note text is sent only to the LLM provider you configure. Your API key is stored unencrypted in the vault. No other network calls.
